notes: VAT at 14% applies only to the manufacturing value of gold and silver jewellery, not the metal value (ETA Executive Regulations on Art. 10(9)). Bullion VAT null: no tax-authority page states a bullion rate (dealer FAQ claim removed). Bar premiums are Goldady's BTC making charges over its live 24K value (EGP 6,403.22/g, 27 Nov 2026): 1g 2.9%, 1000g 0.5%.

sources.name: Egyptian Tax Authority - Executive Regulations of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016 (English)
sources.what: Standard VAT rate is 14% from 1 Jul 2017 (Art. 4). For platinum, gold and silver jewellery, the tax base under Art. 10(9) of the Law is the manufacturing value (announced price per gram less the invoice value), so the 14% falls on the making value only, not the metal value.

sources.name: Goldady - Buy Gold Bars (BTC 24K bar price list)
sources.what: Dealer list read 27 Nov 2026: every bar is priced as weight x Goldady's live 24K buy price (EGP 6,403.22/g) plus a stated making charge (1g EGP 187; 2.5g 280; 5g 435; 10g 840; 20g 1,640; 31.1g 2,456.90; 50g 3,950; 100g 7,700; 250g 8,750; 500g 16,250; 1000g 31,500). Premium per size = making charge / gold value. Goldady states it buys bars back at the live price with no buyback fee, so no buyback discount is coded.
